result.summary: Rework step 01b of WF-01 run M1SITE-20261119-01 by the findings F1-F15 of gate pass 1 (handoffs/M1SITE-20261119-01/step-02-req-validator.json), only inside the blocks REQ-111 and REQ-112 and their comment lines of docs/requirements.yaml: lines 1-15171 byte-equal (sha256 3fdee311… before and after, equal to the tag), the blocks grew from 793 to 980 lines, the file loads as YAML (112 requirements; REQ-111 16 criteria, REQ-112 10, both pending, the fields id, title, owner, status, depends_on and original_request unchanged), and a YAML compare shows every untouched paragraph and criterion equal and every edited one equal to the intended text. F1: the port headers name the original, its commit and the sha256 of its bytes; port-parity.test.js compares hashes with no git command (the checkouts of app.yml keep one commit, measured), RELEASE-VALIDATOR checks the commit in a full clone by `git show … | shasum -a 256`; criterion 11's clone is of depth 1 and keeps .git (on the tag with the unlisted paths removed: app check exit 0, 45 and 36 tests; without .git 8 of 13 tests are red); no checkout change and no new ci-workflow rule. F2: both demo routes of the function entry answer only ru and en (criterion 7 rows for POST …/result?lang=kk, criterion 9 (g), the post-deploy record). F3: the kk-draft script compares strings of three or more words (runs of Unicode letters and digits) from both sets, a hit is a whole phrase between word borders, 150 compared strings measured (Python and JavaScript agree); the short words such as kk «Авто» are never compared. F4: every demo result, also the no-match one that five «Не знаю» always give, shows the closed list «Чего Sai пока не делает» of PLAN §2 with ten exact ru texts (texts test, the e2e for every fixture and for five «Не знаю» in each language, the public set, the post-deploy record; question О19). F5: the departure from ARCH §19.3 is named with its reason (question О20). F6: REQ-112 criterion 6 measures no page scroll and the stage box inside the window, the wider canvas clipped by the stage, as the look description says. F7: criterion 4 names the palette of the look description, its derived colours and constants, every marker found back. F8: the departures (1)-(6) are listed for Plan amendments rows (question О21). F9: identifier borders and named twins for every code form; the HTML-from-string forms are a closed list of ten. F10: criterion 1 by tags and attributes, root-relative addresses read without query and anchor, the 404 page at nested paths. F11: the e2e lints what each page shows; the readers mark ordering pairs outside order_. F12: criterion 3 names the seven globals of Node 22 replaced by traps (measured). F13: decisions/0084 §3 item 11 and decisions/0118 О12 named as not applying. F14: 29 names and handles in the grep and a script for the sample's 11 phone numbers by their digits. F15: no edit. Every new fact was measured at this step outside the project and is listed in the blocks (REQ-111 facts 14-19, REQ-112 facts 7-10). Open questions with defaults for decision 0123: О17 (its default changed), О19, О20, О21; three points for gate 03b of the look description (issue I6).

О17, the parity oracle — its default changed by F1. Default now: each port header names the original's path, the commit it was ported from and the sha256 of the original's bytes at that commit; app/test/unit/port-parity.test.js compares the sha256 of the current original with the header, with no git command, so it holds in the check job of app.yml, which keeps one commit; RELEASE-VALIDATOR checks the commit in a full clone (`git show <commit>:<path> | shasum -a 256` = the header hash); app.yml's paths hold the two originals because the test imports them. Alternatives: (a) `fetch-depth: 0` in the check job of app.yml and `git show` in the test, with a rule and a damaged copy in ci-workflow.test.js — not chosen: every push then fetches the whole history for one test, and the header could still never name the pushed commit; (b) frozen copies of the originals as test fixtures (no path in app.yml, but a second copy of the owner's code in app/test).

О19, the list «Чего Sai пока не делает» on the public demo result (F4). Default: every result shows it, the no-match one included, on production in ru and en, with the ten exact ru texts of REQ-111 that cover each item of PLAN §2 «What they do not build in V1» once; these are no order texts under G8 «б» (they say what Sai does not build and offer nothing; PLAN M1 «Owner sees» names them in the demo result, decisions/0092 item 5 keeps the demo public, PLAN §2 says «The landing and the interview say so plainly»). This also answers the gate's I6 for the result: ORCH may confirm in decisions/0123 that the demo result is not an order text. Alternatives: the list only on the local server (then the public result says nothing of what Sai cannot build, against PLAN M1); another wording or grouping of the PLAN items (a micro-amendment of criterion 2).

О20, the departure from ARCH §19.3 (F5). Default: in R1.2 the public languages are one constant of the source; the build leaves kk out of the public set and the function entry answers both demo routes in ru and en; kk is shown only by a release after the owner's answer to G9; ORCH writes a row of PROGRESS «Plan amendments» citing decisions/0123; when the admin of M5 exists, a later requirement may move the switch into platform_settings with kk still out of the public files until G9. Alternative (the form §19.3 allows): public_langs read from platform_settings at run time — not chosen: the kk texts would have to be in the public files and only hidden, so the kk draft would be served (against G9's default and PLAN NEVER-DO 14); the demo routes would read the database (against REQ-111 criterion 8); and no admin can change the setting before M5.

О21, the rows of PROGRESS «Plan amendments» (F8).
